sections.name: Ostkustleden Etapp 3, Lönhult - Krokstorp

estimatedTime.notes: No official section-specific walking time found in the 2026-04-29 source pass. Field reports vary from about 4 hours in 2009 to 8 hours in 2015, but those are not official estimates.

difficulty.notes: No official difficulty grade found on Naturkartan or maintainer pages. Field reports describe rough/overgrown sections, but do not convert that into an official grade.

start.label: Lönhult official GPX / Etapp 2-3 snap point

sourceSummary.classification: navigation-grade after explicit ordering/reversal and snapping minor gaps under 35 m; as-stored GPX is not import-ready

caveats: Naturkartan page says 20.5 km, normalized GPX computes 20.549165 km with small joins, Döderhult/OSM/Pacer round to about 21 km, and raw GPX concatenation gives a false 54.841849 km because tracks are not in route order.
Official GPX and API contain ten pieces in non-sequential order and mixed directions.
PDF text extraction may read Krokshult, while official page, cabin page, map labels, and OSM use Krokstorp.

Naturkartan says well water on yard and lake water must be boiled if the well dries; Döderhult says the well water may be brown but potable; field reports from 2009, 2015 and 2017 repeatedly describe poor/low/cloudy water.

A 2015 field report says the overnight cabin is not the first cabin by the lake/bathing place and not directly on the shore, while official route text generally says Krokstorp/Krokstorpsjön near the endpoint.
Krokshult naturreservat has strict visitor rules but Etapp 3 overlap was not confirmed. Viråns vattensystem Natura 2000 contact near Lönhult/Näjern was found.
Krokstorp Naturkartan stop and GTFS-derived Krokstorp östra appear to refer to the same cluster, but service pattern and names differ, and seasonal timetable dates affect currentness.
